verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents a native MCP server at POST /mcp through which an agent can create indexes, add documents, configure settings and run searches. A single API and official typed SDKs cover the same flow programmatically, and llms.txt and markdown docs support agent consumption. One hobbyist reported that index setup took substantial coding effort, but that speaks to effort rather than capability. Missing for 10: any evidence of an official CLI, a discoverable OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of an agent driving the full flow via MCP.
